column1: # Daily Language Game, base language entries. One per line: Name<TAB>tier
# Accent varieties are NOT listed here; they reuse their base language's
# Glottocode with a variety suffix (see tech-stack.md entry record).
# Esperanto deliberately absent: no geographic footprint, unscoreable.
# English varieties, added 2026-11-01. Glottolog models most of these as dialect
# nodes of English [stan1293] with their own Glottocodes, so they resolve through
# the same path as a language and need no suffix mechanism. Scottish English is
# the exception and carries a local id, see data/local-ids.tsv.
# Only nativised varieties are here. A learner's accent (German-accented English,
# Spanish-accented English) is excluded on purpose: guessing the speaker's first
# language duplicates the language pool exactly and has no footprint of its own.
# Tier is geographic distinctiveness, so North American English sits in tier 3
# despite being the most recognisable of the lot. Its footprint is a continent.
# Bare "English" was narrowed to this on 2026-11-01. With the accent layer in
# place its footprint was the whole anglosphere, 34 territories, which cannot be
# scored. Southeastern English [sout3285] is southeast England including London.
